title: Find Leaves of Binary Tree
description: Collect and remove all leaves of a binary tree level by level until the tree is empty.

steps.note: Starting DFS to find height of nodes. Tree: [1,2,3,4,5]
Traversing to node 4 (leaf), height will be 0
Node 4 is a leaf (height 0), added to result[0]
Traversing to node 5 (leaf), height will be 0
Node 5 is a leaf (height 0), added to result[0]
Node 2 has children 4,5. Height is max(0,0)+1 = 1
Node 2 is level 1, added to result[1]
Node 3 is level 0, added to result[0]
Node 1 has children 2 (h=1) and 3 (h=0). Height is max(1,0)+1 = 2
Node 1 is level 2, added to result[2]
